fields.issue: P2 seams and bond films are a mass recipe, not checked structural joints. P3 percent joints are an allowance, not strength or rotational stiffness. Folded source joints sized at p0 cannot automatically take a larger float pressure.
fields.next_evidence: Size and qualify seal, splice, node and load-introduction details at the maximum service pressure, including stiffness, eccentricity, fatigue and leakage.
